name: Get any website's brand kit as files (logo, CSS variables, design tokens) with MiroMiro

parameters.content:
## Get any website's brand kit as files with MiroMiro

### How it works
Get any website's brand kit as files in one zip. **Extract Brand Kit** reads the brand colors with their roles, fonts and logo of the site in **Set Website URL**, and **Extract Design Tokens** reads every color, font size, spacing and radius as W3C Design Tokens. The zip holds the logo, `brand.css` (colors and fonts as CSS variables), `tokens.json` (for Figma variables, Style Dictionary or Tokens Studio) and `brand.md`, a readable summary that says whether the colors were declared by the site or inferred. If the logo cannot be downloaded, the kit is built without it. Failed calls are not charged.

### Setup
This template uses the verified community node **n8n-nodes-miromiro** (tested with version 0.1.4 on n8n 1.123).
1. On n8n Cloud, search "MiroMiro" in the nodes panel (an admin may need to turn on Verified Community Nodes). Self-hosted: Settings > Community nodes > Install `n8n-nodes-miromiro`, see https://docs.n8n.io/integrations/community-nodes/installation/
2. Get a free MiroMiro API key (300 credits a month, no card): https://miromiro.app/api/onboarding
3. Open **Extract Brand Kit** > Credential > Create new, and paste the key.
4. Select the same credential in **Extract Design Tokens**.
5. Set your website in **Set Website URL** and click **Execute workflow**.
6. Download the zip from **Zip the Brand Kit**.

Each website costs 20 credits (10 brand + 10 tokens). The same site again within 24 hours is free.

### Customization
Read the websites from a Google Sheet to build kits for a list of clients or prospects. Send the zip to Google Drive, Notion or email. Remove **Extract Design Tokens** if you only need colors, fonts and logo (10 credits).

![The workflow, in case the preview does not load](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SoraiaBarroso/n8n-nodes-miromiro/main/docs/templates/brand-kit-files.png)

parameters.jsCode:
const brand = $('Extract Brand Kit').first().json
const tokens = $('Extract Design Tokens').first().json
const host = String($('Set Website URL').first().json.website).split('/')[2].replace(/^www\./, '')
const file = (text, fileName, mimeType) => ({ data: Buffer.from(text).toString('base64'), fileName, mimeType })
const c = brand.colors || {}
const fonts = brand.fonts || []
const palette = (brand.palette || []).slice(0, 12)
const roles = ['primary', 'accent', 'background', 'text'].filter(k => c[k])

// brand.css: the named colors, the palette and the fonts as CSS variables.
const css = [
  '/* Brand of ' + host + ', extracted by MiroMiro (https://miromiro.app/api) */',
  ':root {',
  ...roles.map(k => '  --brand-' + k + ': ' + c[k] + ';'),
  ...palette.map((p, i) => '  --palette-' + (i + 1) + ': ' + p.color + ';  /* ' + p.name + ' */'),
  ...fonts.map((f, i) => '  --font-' + (i + 1) + ': "' + f + '", sans-serif;'),
  '}',
].join('\n')

// tokens.json: the W3C Design Tokens file as MiroMiro returned it.
const { usage, ...dtcg } = tokens

// brand.md: a readable summary.
const md = [
  '# Brand of ' + host,
  '',
  '## Colors',
  ...roles.map(k => '- **' + k + ':** ' + c[k]),
  '',
  '## Palette',
  ...palette.map(p => '- ' + p.color + ' (' + p.name + ', used ' + p.count + 'x)'),
  '',
  '## Fonts',
  ...fonts.map(f => '- ' + f),
  '',
  '## Logo',
  brand.logo || 'none found',
  '',
  '## How sure is this?',
  'Confidence: ' + brand.confidence + ' (0 to 1)',
  (brand.signals && brand.signals.explanation) || '',
].join('\n')

const binary = {
  css: file(css, 'brand.css', 'text/css'),
  tokens: file(JSON.stringify(dtcg, null, 2), 'tokens.json', 'application/json'),
  summary: file(md, 'brand.md', 'text/markdown'),
}
const logo = $('Download Logo File').first().binary?.data
if (logo) binary.logo = { ...logo, fileName: 'logo.' + (logo.fileExtension || 'png') }
return [{ json: { website: host, colors: c, fonts }, binary, pairedItem: { item: 0 } }]

parameters.content:
## Choose the website

Put the website in **Set Website URL**.

## Read the brand

MiroMiro reads the brand (colors, fonts, logo) and every design token, and the logo file is downloaded.

## Build and zip

The results become brand.css, tokens.json, brand.md and the logo, in one zip.
